holds.reason: Two changes need our side first (task-1793083762-bu58fd). 0.39 types select().from(source) as a conditional over the source, which TypeScript cannot resolve for a generic table: infra/retention's sweepExpired (select().from(T) feeding T's rows to beforeDelete) fails type-check on 0.43.1 and 0.45.4, and the cast-free fix needs a typed path for generic tables. 0.44 then wraps every driver error in DrizzleQueryError (the Postgres error under .cause), and ~21 production files classify Postgres errors by err.code / message, which would silently misclassify (0.45.4: six tests failed). Checked 2026-10-27. Lift with that task.

plugin-react 6.0 removed every Babel feature, the `babel` option included (vitejs/vite-plugin-react#1123): Babel plugins move to @rolldown/plugin-babel (reactCompilerPreset) or the experimental native compiler. Our React Compiler reaches the build through that option (web-core vite-contributions, web-artifacts vite-builder), so 6.1.2 failed type-check on 2026-10-27; moving changes how every web artifact compiles and is a build-pipeline change of its own (task-1793076072-gwttlf). Lift with that migration. (Vite 8 itself is in: 5.x peers it.)

TypeScript 7.0 ships no programmatic compiler API (its main entry exports only `version`; the API is under `typescript/unstable/*` until 7.1). typescript-eslint, which runs our type-aware lint in the type-check check, does not support TS 7 (closed as not planned in #12518, tracked in #10940), and our 25 compiler-API users (codegen, scanners) crash on `ts.ScriptTarget`. Checked 2026-10-19 against 7.0.2: regen-generated fails with `undefined is not an object (evaluating 'ts.ScriptTarget.Latest')`. Lift when typescript-eslint supports TS 7.
